description: 52 failed logins for user 'admin' from one IP in 2 minutes, followed by a successful login.
User clicked a link in an email from 'micros0ft-support.com' asking to verify their password.
Successful login from Chennai, then another from Frankfurt 20 minutes later for the same user.
Word opened on FIN-APP-02 and launched PowerShell with an encoded command.
3,400 files renamed with a .locked extension on the file server within 4 minutes.
6 failed logins over 30 minutes from the office network, then a successful login. User later reported forgetting the password.
Port scan detected from internal host 10.0.5.20, which is the approved vulnerability scanner, during its scheduled weekly scan.
Admin privileges granted to user 'dev.intern' at 3 AM, outside any change window, with no ticket.
